title: Employee Experience & Satisfaction
description: Measures the internal impact of Adobe Experience Platform and other Adobe apps on teams, focusing on time savings, automation, and employee satisfaction.
sourceUseCases: Email Automation (expand automation program to all regions, reduce admin overhead ~15%)
Promo Kits (rapidly create scalable promo content; auto-publish with PeM; reduce admin hours)
formulas: Employee Score = (Baseline Hours - Actual Hours) / Baseline Hours × 100
SLA Efficiency = (Previous SLA - Current SLA) / Previous SLA × 100
whyBusiness: For executives, satisfaction KPIs show whether automation reduces grunt work and boosts morale while scaling delivery.
whyTechnical: For technical leads, confirms system automation, usability, and efficiency improvements.

title: Audience Growth & Quality
description: How well Adobe Experience Platform drives richer, higher-quality audiences.
sourceUseCases: Audience Selection & Enrichment (create and size audiences using 1P + 3P data)
AES-Driven Lists (profile accounts with AES features and engagement scores)
formulas: Account Engagement Score = Weighted interactions ÷ Accounts
whyBusiness: For Marissa, audience KPIs prove whether top-of-funnel growth is materializing.
whyTechnical: Validates ingestion pipelines, AES, and schema functioning.

title: Campaign Activations & Velocity
description: Measures speed, scale, and efficiency of campaign execution.
sourceUseCases: Journey Path Optimization (orchestrate journeys across channels)
Live Event & Webinar Orchestration (pre/post event activation + sales insights)
formulas: TTM Reduction % = (Prev Avg Days - Current Avg Days) ÷ Prev Avg Days × 100
whyBusiness: For marketers, speed and efficiency of campaigns = direct growth lever.
whyTechnical: For engineers, validates pipelines and orchestration reliability.

title: Pipeline & Revenue Impact
description: Tracks contribution of marketing to pipeline and revenue acceleration.
sourceUseCases: Intent Data in CRM (weekly intent data feeds enriched in Dynamics, powering BDR)
Automated Delivery of Targeting Lists (showing pipeline lift via targeting efficiency)
whyBusiness: For leaders, ties AEP directly to pipeline acceleration.
whyTechnical: Confirms cross-system sync and attribution reliability.

title: Customer & DX Stakeholder Experience Impact
description: Impact on engagement, retention, and overall experience.
sourceUseCases: Create Audiences via SOI × Intent and POI × Intent
BDR Content Orchestration (scale account-based orchestration via GenStudio)
whyBusiness: For Marissa, engagement and retention prove business outcomes.
whyTechnical: For engineers, validates stitching, identity, and data completeness.

title: Operational Efficiencies
description: Marketing cost and time efficiency improvements.
sourceUseCases: Contact Discovery & Upload (use AJO B2B for prioritized contact lists)
AES Alerts (surface surging accounts; trigger BDR outreach + Slack notifications)
whyBusiness: For executives, efficiency metrics show ROI from consolidation.
whyTechnical: Confirms workflow automation and error reduction.
